persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a vertical poster and a matching 8-second reel for our night market. Both should say: “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, “Free entry”. Warm illustrated food stalls and string lights, please. Keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them. No sound.
bank.Deliverables: One still poster and one matching animated reel, delivered separately.
bank.Size and platform: Both vertical 9:16, for sharing on social media; free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Wording and language: English. Both must read exactly: Night Market; Saturday 12 July; 6–10 pm; Riverside Yard; Free entry. No additional event information is needed.
bank.Style and mood: Warm, welcoming illustrated food stalls with string lights. Specific colours, fonts and layout are your call.
bank.Length and animation: Eight seconds. Keep every event detail readable throughout, with subtle animation behind the text.
bank.Audio and voice: Silent, with no music, speech or sound effects.

messages.text: Could you make a poster and a matching reel for our night market, please? I’m excited about sharing this because the market is something I’ve really been looking forward to. The poster should be vertical, and the matching reel should be 8 seconds long, with both saying “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, and “Free entry”. For the look, I’d like warm illustrated food stalls and string lights. Please keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them, and no sound.
